title: The public /start lead action has no rate limit or honeypot and enrolls any typed email into a nurture series, so a stranger can make Frequency email third parties.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: PLAUSIBLE. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: app/(marketing)/start/actions.ts:30-125 captureLead is a 'use server' action with zero rateLimitOk calls (grep count 0); it upserts contacts with consent_state 'unknown' (line ~102) and calls enrollInNurture({contactId,email,persona}) (line ~121). lib/nurture/enroll.ts:19-40 enrolls with no double opt-in; lib/nurture/runner.ts:155 only skips consent_state === 'unsubscribed', so 'unknown' is mailed. Sibling actions (join/lead-actions.ts, subscribe/actions.ts:38, contact-form-actions.ts:92) do rate-limit.

WHY IT MATTERS: Anyone can script the action with victims' addresses: mail goes out under the Frequency domain to people who never asked, which means complaints, Resend reputation damage and Jan 1 deliverability risk. Also lets bots fill contacts with junk. Only bites if the persona's nurture sequence is enabled in production (could not check the DB).

FIX DIRECTION: Add rateLimitOk by IP and by email plus the same honeypot field the create-space draft uses, and enroll in nurture only after the address is confirmed (or consent_state is subscribed).

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
